about: The fixture shard of .github/workflows/live-probe-go-proof.yml (R-LP-91): two Go repositories with no registry package, built in the sandbox at their commit with `go install`. The workflow sends subject, run_key and fence as the items input. Neither server can list tools with no arguments (mark3labs/mcp-filesystem-server needs an allowed directory, isaacphi/mcp-language-server a workspace and a language server binary), so the proof is the build, its egress and the start, not a grade; what each ends with is printed, never required to be a grade.
